# CS2 Modding Handbook

> A source-verified, technique-organized handbook for writing Cities: Skylines II (CS2) code and UI mods. Built for AI coding agents and human modders. Every code claim is cited to a real, public mod at a pinned commit. Organized by Diataxis mode (tutorials / how-to / reference / explanation) plus worked case studies.

This file is the agent entry point. Pages are self-contained markdown. Start with the Technique Index to pick an approach, then jump to the matching how-to recipe; use Reference for lookups and Explanation for concepts. Every page declares a `status` (`source-verified` = code claims cited to a mod at a pinned commit; `needs-verification` = no pinned source or hedged) and currency fields (`source_version`/`last_reverified`). Current live game: 1.6.0f1 "Summer Solstice" (2026-06-22), SDK 2.1.2.

## Start here
- [README](README.md): human orientation, the Diataxis map, and the full chapter index.
- [AGENTS](AGENTS.md): operating manual - the rules for reading, citing, and contributing (read before editing).
- [Technique Index](technique-index.md): "which technique, when" - the catalog of modding technique families, their canonical mods, applicability, and coverage status. The best place to choose an approach.

## Tutorials (learning - zero to a running mod)
- [Getting started](tutorials/getting-started.md): install the toolchain, set developer flags, verify your environment.
- [Your first code mod](tutorials/first-code-mod.md): scaffold, name, and build a C# code mod from the template.
- [Your first UI mod](tutorials/first-ui-mod.md): scaffold a React/TypeScript UI bundle (npx create-csii-ui-mod) and wire the MSBuild UI build.
- [Build and publish](tutorials/build-and-publish.md): the daily build loop and publishing to PDX Mods.

## Explanation (concepts)
- [ECS/DOTS fundamentals](explanation/ecs-fundamentals.md): writing the OnUpdate body - EntityQuery, ComponentLookup, EntityCommandBuffer/sync points, DynamicBuffer, Burst/IJobChunk. Read before coding a system.
- [Harmony patching](explanation/harmony-patching.md): prefix/postfix/transpiler/reverse-patch, targeting overloaded/by-ref methods, PatchAll vs manual, Burst/collision hazards.
- [React UI (consume side)](explanation/react-ui.md): the Gameface/React consume model - useValue/trigger/engine.on, moduleRegistry, the C#<->TSX boundary.
- [Research hygiene](explanation/research-hygiene.md): how to tell when a mod's internals are verifiable, what is auth-gated, and how to gate an honest gap instead of fabricating one.
- [Mod lifecycle & initialization](explanation/mod-lifecycle.md): what IMod.OnLoad/OnDispose do and the canonical bootstrap order.
- [System scheduling](explanation/system-scheduling.md): SystemUpdatePhase, UpdateBefore/After, and update-interval tuning.
- [Multi-phase scheduling](explanation/multi-phase-scheduling.md): registering one system across several phases (Deserialize/Serialize/gameplay) and branching on context.
- [Module layout](explanation/module-layout.md): one identifier for assembly/namespace/mod-ID, folder shape, and the CSII_TOOLPATH MSBuild import.
- [Dependency strategy](explanation/dependency-strategy.md): declare/reference/validate/degrade for shared libraries; runtime assembly detection.
- [Save/load serialization](explanation/serialization.md): the Serialize/Deserialize phases, ISerializable/IDefaultSerializable, and versioned payloads.
- [System replacement](explanation/system-replacement.md): why/when to disable a vanilla system and register a replacement, and the risks.
- [Conditional execution](explanation/conditional-execution.md): RequireForUpdate, GameMode gates, early-outs, and dev-mode diagnostics.
- [Settings vs data](explanation/settings-and-data.md): choosing between ModSetting, ECS save-stream, and side-car JSON.
- [Gameface runtime](explanation/gameface-runtime.md): the Coherent/Gameface constraints and the C#<->React boundary.
- [UI <-> C# communication](explanation/ui-cs-communication.md): the ValueBinding / TriggerBinding model on UISystemBase.

## Reference (lookup)
- [Game systems: economy](reference/game-systems/economy.md): vanilla economy systems/components/hook points (EconomyUtils price getters, WorkProvider, tax/budget). Patch-sensitive.
- [Game systems: citizens & households](reference/game-systems/citizens-households.md): citizen/household/worker/student components, needs, behavior, death. Patch-sensitive.
- [Game systems: districts & policies](reference/game-systems/districts-policies.md): district area components and modifier buffers (policy system largely unverified). Patch-sensitive.
- [Game systems: pathfinding & transit](reference/game-systems/pathfinding-transit.md): the transit perceived-cost model, PathUtils drive-spec getters, PathfindCosts, CarLaneFlags, and the CS2 speed-unit (/1.8) gotcha. Patch-sensitive.
- [System update phases](reference/system-update-phases.md): the SystemUpdatePhase members mods actually schedule into, with meaning + ordering, each cited.
- [SDK & toolchain](reference/sdk-and-toolchain.md): Mod.props/Mod.targets/CSII_TOOLPATH, the Colossal/Game/Unity assemblies, the IMod surface.
- [ECS components catalog](reference/ecs-components-catalog.md): vanilla Game.* components/systems the corpus reads/writes, each cited to a real mod. Patch-sensitive.
- [Glossary](reference/glossary.md): DOTS/ECS/CS2/modding vocabulary A-Z.
- [Performance & terminology](reference/performance-and-terminology.md): DOTS/ECS/Burst glossary and how to set project-specific perf targets.
- [Options UI attributes](reference/options-attributes.md): lookup table of [SettingsUI*] attributes (corpus-verified vs unverified marked).
- Shared libraries: [overview](reference/shared-libraries/README.md), [Unified Icon Library](reference/shared-libraries/unified-icon-library.md) (modId 74417, coui:// icons), [ExtraLib](reference/shared-libraries/extralib.md) (modId 75724, COUI host + ExtraPanels).
- [External resources](reference/external-resources.md): official CS2 wiki, PDX Mods, community canon, key libraries (link-out).

## Case studies (worked examples)
- [Realistic Path Finding](case-studies/realistic-path-finding.md): system replacement + reflection bridge + Burst jobs.
- [Anarchy](case-studies/anarchy.md): flag-bit error suppression, orthogonal Harmony patches, network composition, XML persistence.
- [Achievement Fixer](case-studies/achievement-fixer.md): windowed flag enforcement + install-once localized banner override, no Harmony.
- [Better Bulldozer](case-studies/better-bulldozer.md): raycast retargeting (Harmony), sub-element removal, UISystemBase bindings, debounced deletes.
- [Extra Detailing Suite](case-studies/extra-detailing-suite.md): transform-gizmo tool, reflective snap framework, prefab UIObject override.
- [Time2Work (Realistic Trips)](case-studies/time2work-realistic-trips.md): ISerializable schedules, reflection bridges, full-getter Harmony, Burst, climate override.
- [Write Everywhere ecosystem](case-studies/write-everywhere-ecosystem.md): reverse-patch bridge API, COUI host both ways, TypeScript moduleRegistry UI.
- [Localization & UI stack](case-studies/localization-and-ui.md): UIL icon hosting + I18n Everywhere localization-dictionary hook.
- [Advanced Road Naming](case-studies/advanced-road-naming.md): pure-ECS IDefaultSerializable + NameSystem custom names + N-waypoint tool + drag-select + overlay, no Harmony.
- [Outside Traffic Adjuster](case-studies/outside-traffic-adjuster.md): the minimal worked example - prefab-field override (family A) + a 4-slider settings screen (family N).
- [Magic Mail](case-studies/magic-mail.md): periodic UpdateInterval system + DynamicBuffer<Resources> nudging + one-shot non-stacking prefab multiplier.
- [Asset Packs Manager](case-studies/asset-packs-manager.md): playset/asset-pack management (storefront-described; source unverified).
- [Traffic Tool Essentials](case-studies/traffic-tool-essentials.md): 3 layered no-Harmony ECS subsystems - Green Wave gate-only sync, Depot polygon-zones, ring-buffer stats.
- [Market Based Economy](case-studies/market-based-economy.md): manual price postfixes + elastic-price manager + WorkProvider floor + profit-tax + IMGUI analytics.
- [Road Speed Adjuster](case-studies/road-speed-adjuster.md): durable vanilla-network write (survives uninstall) + three-layer persistence + drag-select tool.
- [Smooth Left-Hand Traffic](case-studies/smooth-left-hand-traffic.md): PrefabUpdate subnet inversion + eligibility scan + host->upgrade recursion + MouseToolOptions button.
- [Realistic Job Search](case-studies/realistic-jobsearch.md): PathfindSetupSystem candidate rewrite + gravity/softmax + acceptance-gate veto + CSV telemetry.
- [Magic Garbage Truck](case-studies/magic-garbage-truck.md): IconCommandBuffer purge + one-shot rescale + self-restoring disable + refresh-on-read status.
- [Advanced Simulation Speed](case-studies/advanced-simulation-speed.md): SimulationSystem.selectedSpeed control + moduleRegistry.extend toolbar augmentation + polled binding.
- [Abandoned Building Remover](case-studies/abandoned-building-remover.md): ECS structural cascade deletion + MSBuild Burst/managed dual-path.
- [Elections (Realistic Trips module)](case-studies/elections-rt-module.md): a module-mod extending a host's private sim - RT trip protocol, hand-built Event archetype, versioned save.
- [Custom Chirps](case-studies/custom-chirps.md): Chirper feed injection - message-id tagging, token/marker binding, runtime-loc prefix, async image pipeline, provider bridge.
- [Demand Modifier](case-studies/demand-modifier.md): research-hygiene cautionary - attribute-only settings verified; the live ECS mechanism is storefront-only/gated.

## Status
The Diataxis structure is complete and populated: tutorials, how-to (recipes + tooling/ui/content/operations/localization), reference, explanation, and case studies are all live and listed above. Content is generalized (no single-project coupling) and, where `status: source-verified`, cited to real public mods at pinned commits. Source pins span ~1.4 to 1.6.0f1 (several at the current 1.6.0f1); the current live game is 1.6.0f1 - see each page's `source_version`/`last_reverified`. New recipes and case studies continue to land via the fold-in loop as more mods are studied; see the Technique Index for coverage and the "wanted" gaps.
